target: WO-4 nearby-DA cost key-null + WO-5 shadow sun_altitude/azimuth key-null
findings_summary: WO-4: conveyancing_db.fetch_nearby_das SELECTs cost_of_development + unpacks as `cost` but the returned dict omits it -> brief's NearbyDA.cost always null. Fix: add cost_of_development to the returned dict. WO-5: shadow_detector per-scenario dict never emits sun_altitude_deg/sun_azimuth_deg; brief reads them. Fix: emit from the pvlib solar-position calc if available, else drop the 2 fields from the brief read. Pure key-null, no schema/DB change.
